Trump Bans CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from White House

U.S. President Donald Trump announced he is banning CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House premises, effective immediately. He stated in a Truth Social post that the ban is a result of their "constant 'reporting' FAKE NEWS!" and that they report "fiction and lies." Trump also indicated that "other Fake News Media Outlets to follow" but did not specify which ones. This action marks a significant move against media outlets he perceives as adversarial.
